technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish momentum (RSI rising, force index cross-up) conflicts with bearish intermediate structure (price below 50/200 SMAs, below cloud); overbought conditions and weak ADX suggest limited follow-through potential.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, earnings in 48 days presents timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying signal from junior members 104+ days ago; market fear (38/100) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirming news data and recent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (432.48), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational earnings, CPI event imminent, and earnings binary 48 days out—risk environment highly unfavourable for TXN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI rising, force index cross-up, supertrend bullish) with support at 144.09 provides defined risk entry for mean-reversion trade in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), price trapped below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), overbought oscillators without trend confirmation, and high earnings risk in 48 days make this a low-probability swing setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (RSI rising, force index cross-up) offer tactical mean-reversion appeal in fear-driven market; however, conviction is insufficient given macro headwinds and structural weakness.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with price trapped below all major moving averages and earnings binary 48 days out creates asymmetric downside risk with limited follow-through probability.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical momentum insufficient to override fundamental, sentiment, and macro weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration in IT and no existing TXN position; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows sizing flexibility, but macro environment and risk score (2/10) argue against entry regardless of portfolio capacity.
